title: Contains Duplicate
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return `false` if every element is distinct.
hints: Brute force compares every pair — O(n^2). Can you check membership faster?
A set lets you check 'have I seen this before?' in O(1) average time.
Walk the array once, adding each value to a set. If a value is already in the set before you add it, you've found a duplicate.

solution.approach: Use a hash set to track values seen so far. Iterate through the array once; for each value, check if it's already in the set. If so, a duplicate exists and we return true immediately. Otherwise, add it to the set and continue. If we finish the loop without finding a repeat, all values are distinct.
